informative.title: Trim boundary NaN samples
informative.summary: Removes leading and trailing NaN samples while preserving internal missing samples.
informative.description: Extracts the unchanged contiguous span from the first through the last finite sample of a one-dimensional signal.
notes: Trimming does not interpolate gaps or remove internal NaN samples.
The output does not retain the original time offset.

definitions.text: If signal contains finite samples, retain every sample from the first finite sample through the last finite sample, inclusive, without changing values or order.
Return the retained span, including every internal NaN. If signal is empty or contains only NaN samples, return an empty vector. A single finite sample is sufficient.

behavior.nan_handling: Remove only leading and trailing NaN runs. Preserve internal NaN samples exactly. Inf, -Inf, and complex data are invalid.
behavior.empty_input: An empty signal returns an empty trimmed_signal without warnings.
behavior.input_orientation: Row and column vectors represent the same canonical one-dimensional sequence. Matrix and higher-dimensional inputs are outside the normative contract. trimmed_signal is a one-dimensional ordered vector; its physical orientation is implementation-specific.
behavior.insufficient_data: An all-NaN signal returns an empty vector without warnings. One finite sample returns a one-element vector without warnings.
